facts.fact: The Smart Rwanda 2020 Master Plan lists an ICT Innovation Center project of USD 5.6 million with a 24-month duration led by RDB, a Kigali Innovation City, an ICT innovation fund for 100 start-ups and a women and girls in ICT incubation programme.
facts.system: ICT Innovation Center and Kigali Innovation City

note: as_of is the plan's published month, 2015-10, as the plan gives no event date.
